entry.summary:
Why Activation Is No Longer a Single Workflow — But a Coordinated System
For a long time, service activation in telecom followed a fairly predictable pattern. A request entered the OSS. When something failed, teams traced the workflow, identified the step that broke, and fixed it. That model made sense when networks were tightly controlled and services were closely tied to physical infrastructure. But that model doesn’t hold up anymore. In modern telecom environments, service activation is no longer a single workflow moving through a centralized system.
